name: io.github.lagaam-ai/lagaam
title: Lagaam
description: Stops an agent's Trino or Pinot query before it runs if it costs too much or reads outside its grant

environmentVariables.name: LAGAAM_ALLOWED_TABLES
environmentVariables.description: Comma list of catalog.schema.table grants; the server will not start without it

environmentVariables.name: LAGAAM_ALLOW_ALL_TABLES
environmentVariables.description: true to run with no grant at all: an explicit opt-out, off by default

environmentVariables.name: PINOT_USER
environmentVariables.description: Pinot user; unset means no auth

environmentVariables.name: PINOT_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Pinot password; unset means no auth

environmentVariables.name: LAGAAM_AGENT_NAME
environmentVariables.description: Identity stamped on the audit trail

environmentVariables.name: LAGAAM_MAX_SCAN_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Scan-bytes budget per query, checked before it runs (default 50 GiB)

environmentVariables.name: LAGAAM_MAX_ROWS
environmentVariables.description: Scanned-row estimate budget per query; unset means ungated

environmentVariables.name: LAGAAM_MAX_INTERMEDIATE_ROWS
environmentVariables.description: Rows the engine would build at its widest step, not rows returned, so a LIMIT doesn't lower it

environmentVariables.name: LAGAAM_MAX_RETURNED_ROWS
environmentVariables.description: Rows returned to the agent per query, capped at 100000; a bigger LIMIT in the query is lowered to it

environmentVariables.name: LAGAAM_AUDIT_LOG
environmentVariables.description: Audit JSONL file path; unset means stderr
